title: Binary heap priority queue
prompt:
Write a ModuleScript that returns a PriorityQueue class. `PriorityQueue.new(less: ((a, b) -> boolean)?)`; the
default order is a < b (smallest first). Methods: `:push(value)`, `:pop()` removes and returns the first value (nil
when empty), `:peek()` returns it without removing, `:size()`. push and pop must be O(log n).
